mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 59 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Public Library and a full moon lighting up the night. With an air quality index of 51, it is slightly elevated. You can catch the ISS passing low across the sky from Mount Horeb toward Belleville at 9:21 PM for one minute. The overnight low will reach 49 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

Construction alert: a section of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for final pavement work. Also, the city's annual fall leaf collection starts on October 5, so please remember to place your loose leaves behind the curb for the vacuum trucks.

Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to Hometown USA Festival Park for the Verona Fall Fest. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers' Market returns to the Capitol Square, and Paddy Mac's continues its music series.
In a notable call from September 10, officers responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where a shot was fired; the suspect was apprehended and a handgun was recovered.
Today's flavor service has concluded for the evening. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow at 10:00 AM when we will be serving our OREO REESE'S Cheesecake flavor of the day.
